board.scene: Static overhead smartphone video of the printed infographic on the clipboard lying on the wooden table. The camera does not move. The hand holding the thin wooden pointer stays almost still. The printed paper and every word of its text stay perfectly still and unchanged. The narration is an off-screen voiceover: no person, face or body appears anywhere in the frame at any time, only the hand holding the pointer, and nobody on screen speaks.
board.voice: Voice: off-screen female narrator, French woman in her late thirties, native Parisian French, warm, confident and intimate social-media voiceover tone, calm natural conversational pace, speaking fluent French.

suffix: Only the narrator's voice, natural quiet room tone, no music, no subtitles, no text added on screen.
